name: track segment element
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 选取相邻钢轨垫层之间轨道区段形成的离散建模单元。
usage_note: 其几何范围由本文建模约定确定，不等同于任意长度线路区段。
usage_overview: 用于轨道有限元离散与组装，在相应模型中按约定取相邻钢轨垫层之间的区段作为基本单元；三维轨道模型中的该单元包含钢轨与轨道板自由度。其范围由建模约定确定，不能泛指任意长度的线路区段。

complete_examples.text: This paper builds the track model using the FEM, and a track segment element (TSE) [18] is taken between two adjacent rail pads, as shown in Figure 3.
The railway track is assembled by track segment element taken between two adjacent rail pads.

In the track segment element, the rails are modeled as elastic Bernoulli–Euler beams supported by discrete viscoelastic rail pads that are assumed to be linear springs and dashpots; moreover, the track slabs are modeled as thin-plate elements, which are connected to the subgrade through the cement asphalt mortar (CA mortar) layer that are regarded as continuous plane springs and dashpots.
